Instead, we retrained our staff to handle escalations and to review the AI's answers."], ["A", "Of course, it wasn't all smooth. In the first few months, the assistant gave some incorrect answers about refunds."], ["A", "So my advice is simple: start small, keep humans in the loop, and measure everything."], ["A", "In a moment, I'll show you some real conversations, and you can judge the results for yourselves."]], {"A": "F-GB"}]
